headline: SK Chairman Sells Over 1.65 Million Shares, Raises 944 Billion Won to Pay Divorce Property Settlement - Liberty Finance
summary: SK Group Chairman Chey Tae-won will sell 1,653,924 shares, equal to 2.3% of issued shares, according to a shareholding disclosure. The sale aims to pay a divorce property settlement.
why: SK Group is a major South Korean conglomerate, and changes in the largest shareholder's holdings are closely watched by investors.
